data.professional_title: AI-Powered Business Analyst | QA Test Lead | Payments & BFSI
data.summary:
AI-Powered Business Analyst and E2E QA Test Lead with 11+ years of experience in Payments and BFSI transformation.
specializing in ISO20022, SWIFT MT/MX, CBPR+, cross-border payments, requirement elicitation, BRD/FSD authoring,
stakeholder management, and end-to-end delivery.
Strong exposure to real-time and cross-border payment initiatives, gap
analysis, process mapping, data mapping, UAT/SIT support, and regulatory change implementation.
Experienced in Agile and
Waterfall delivery, with hands-on use of Jira, Confluence, SQL, Excel, Power BI, TOSCA, Postman, and Selenium.
Completed a
Master's Program in AI-Powered Business Analysis from Simplilearn in collaboration with IBM, gaining hands-on experience in AI-
assisted analytics, Power BI, and agile delivery.
CBPA-certified with a track record of bridging business and technology across
HSBC, CIBC, Standard Chartered, and Citi.

responsibilities: Led Business Analysis and E2E test governance for ISO20022 MT-to-MX payment migration across the UK region, ensuring regulatory compliance across 10+ Lines of Business.
Led ISO20022 MT-to-MX migration and CBPR+ readiness across banking programs, aligning business requirements with regulatory and SWIFT standards.
Supported real-time and cross-border payment transformation initiatives with stakeholder workshops, impact assessments, and data mapping.
Partnered with business, technology, PMO, and testing teams to deliver BRD/FSD, UAT/SIT support, and smooth production transition.
Lead business analysis for liquidity and account management transformation programs for the Germany region, supporting requirements definition, solution design, and stakeholder alignment.
Operated as dual Test Lead + BA: authored BRDs, FSDs, data mappings, and RTMs; facilitated requirement elicitation workshops with BAs, SAs, PMs, and IT teams.
Managed defect triage, daily governance calls, and cross-functional stakeholder alignment; delivered Hybrid Address implementation and ISO version upgrades.
Executed automated regression using TOSCA and Postman; supported UAT with scenario design, walkthroughs, and production validation.
Conducted requirement gathering, workflow mapping, BRD/FSD authoring, and acceptance criteria definition across enterprise banking programs.
Supported real-time and cross-border payment transformation initiatives with stakeholder workshops, impact assessments, and data mapping.
Partnered with business, technology, PMO, and testing teams to deliver BRD/FSD, UAT/SIT support, and smooth production transition.
Converted manual scenarios into Postman/TOSCA automation scripts; performed accessibility testing across 8+ applications; led SIT, E2E, and defect governance.
Performed Business Analysis for payments modules (ITT, ILT, INT, OTT, ONT, OLT); created process flows, data mappings, and user stories.
Led SWIFT STP engine validations achieving 100% STP compliance; supported multi-country UAT planning, execution, and reporting.
Executed SIT, E2E, and API testing for Citi's CDBE platform; built automated regression suites using Selenium and TOSCA; performed production validation and requirement traceability.
